plugins.name: soundcheck
plugins.description: Automated OWASP security checks — Web Top 10:2025, LLM Top 10:2025, API Security Top 10:2023

skills.name: authentication-failures
skills.description: Detects weak password storage, flawed JWT validation, sessions surviving logout, and missing MFA in authentication code. Use when writing login flows, session management, password storage, JWT handling, MFA implementation, credential validation, or any code that authenticates users. Also invoke when implementing "remember me" functionality or API key management.
skills.description_zh: 检查认证代码中的弱密码存储、JWT 校验缺陷、退出后会话存活及缺少 MFA。适用于登录、会话、密码、凭据、记住登录及 API key 管理。

skills.name: broken-access-control
skills.description: Detects missing ownership checks, broken role enforcement, and IDOR vulnerabilities that let users access other users' resources. Use when writing code that checks authorization, enforces resource ownership, handles IDOR (object-level authorization), processes server-side requests to external URLs, or implements access control middleware.
skills.description_zh: 检查资源所有权和角色执行缺失及 IDOR，适用于授权、对象级访问控制、外部 URL 服务端请求和访问控制中间件。

skills.name: concurrency-correctness
skills.description: Detects multi-threaded code where a lock is held across a blocking operation, lock acquisition order risks deadlock, lock-free atomics use the wrong memory ordering, or double-checked locking is missing the necessary barrier. Use when writing or modifying code that acquires multiple locks, uses atomic operations with explicit memory orders (std::memory_order_*, atomic.LoadAcquire, Ordering::Relaxed), implements lazy initialization with double-checked locking, or calls a blocking operation (I/O, sleep, await, blocking channel send) inside a locked region.
skills.description_zh: 检查并发正确性，包括持锁执行阻塞操作、锁顺序死锁、原子内存序错误及双重检查初始化缺屏障。适用于多锁、显式原子序、懒加载及锁区内 I/O、sleep、await 或阻塞通道。

skills.name: contract-review
skills.description: Deep review that audits API contracts for mismatches between what callers assume and what implementations enforce. Designed for nightly CI, pre-release scans, or manual deep audits — runs in tens of minutes, not seconds. Surfaces bugs that single-pass OWASP review misses — caller/callee invariant gaps, trust-anchor confusion, predicate misnaming.
skills.description_zh: 深入审查调用方假设与实现执行的 API 契约差异，寻找不变量缺口、信任锚混淆及谓词误命名，面向夜间 CI、发布前或人工深审。原说明预计数十分钟，区别于单次 OWASP 检查。

skills.name: crypto-library-misuse
skills.description: Detects library-internal cryptographic correctness bugs that pattern matchers and crypto-failures skills miss — AEAD nonce reuse, ECDSA k-value reuse, length-extension on bare hashes, padding-oracle exception distinguishability, and branching on secret material. Use when writing code that calls a crypto primitive directly (AEAD encrypt/decrypt, ECDSA/DSA sign, raw hash, RSA decrypt). Distinct from cryptographic-failures, which covers application-layer choices like MD5 for passwords; this skill is about how primitives are wired up.
skills.description_zh: 检查直接使用加密原语的内部正确性，包括 AEAD nonce 重用、ECDSA k 重用、裸哈希长度扩展、可区分填充错误及按秘密分支。区别于应用层算法选择，适用于直接加解密、签名和原始哈希调用。

skills.name: cryptographic-failures
skills.description: Detects weak or broken cryptography that lets attackers recover plaintext passwords, forge tokens, or decrypt sensitive data. Use when writing code that encrypts or decrypts data, hashes passwords or tokens, generates random values for security purposes, manages cryptographic keys, or configures TLS/SSL settings. Also invoke when storing sensitive data at rest.
skills.description_zh: 检查可能导致密码恢复、令牌伪造和敏感数据解密的弱加密，适用于加解密、密码令牌哈希、安全随机、密钥、TLS/SSL 和静态敏感存储。

skills.name: csrf
skills.description: Detects forms and state-changing endpoints missing CSRF protection. Use when writing HTML forms that submit POST/PUT/DELETE requests, configuring session cookies, or setting up CSRF middleware for web applications. Also invoke when disabling or bypassing CSRF protections in framework configuration.
skills.description_zh: 检查表单和状态变更端点缺少 CSRF 保护，适用于 POST/PUT/DELETE、会话 Cookie、中间件及框架中禁用或绕过保护的配置。

skills.name: exceptional-conditions
skills.description: Detects error handlers that leak stack traces or fail open on exception. Use when writing error handlers, exception catching blocks, try/catch/finally constructs, or API error responses. Also invoke when an application could fail open on exception, or when stack traces might reach end users.
skills.description_zh: 检查错误处理泄漏堆栈或异常后放行，适用于异常捕获、try/catch/finally、API 错误响应和向终端用户暴露堆栈的路径。

skills.name: excessive-agency
skills.description: Detects autonomous agents that take irreversible or high-impact actions without human approval. Use when building autonomous LLM agents, implementing multi-step agent pipelines, writing code where LLM output triggers real-world actions (file writes, API calls, emails, database changes, code execution), or designing agentic workflows with tool use.
skills.description_zh: 检查自主智能体未经人工批准执行不可逆或高影响动作，适用于 LLM 多步流程及由模型输出触发文件、API、邮件、数据库或代码执行的工具工作流。

skills.name: file-upload
skills.description: Detects file upload handlers that accept executable content or write to web- accessible paths without validation. Use when writing file upload handlers, processing multipart form data, saving uploaded files to disk or cloud storage. Also invoke when accepting user-supplied filenames or storing uploads in a web-accessible directory.
skills.description_zh: 检查上传处理是否未校验可执行内容或将文件写入网页可访问位置，适用于 multipart、磁盘云存储、用户文件名及公开上传目录。

skills.name: graphql-security
skills.description: Detects GraphQL schemas without depth limits, cost analysis, or introspection controls. Use when writing GraphQL schemas, resolvers, or server configuration. Also invoke when setting up Apollo Server, graphql-yoga, Strawberry, gqlgen, or any GraphQL framework without explicit depth limiting, cost analysis, or introspection controls.
skills.description_zh: 检查 GraphQL schema 和服务器缺少深度限制、成本分析或 introspection 控制，适用于解析器以及 Apollo、graphql-yoga、Strawberry、gqlgen 等配置。

skills.name: hardcoded-secrets
skills.description: Detects API keys, passwords, tokens, and credentials embedded directly in source code. Use when writing code that contains API keys, passwords, tokens, connection strings, or private keys as string literals. Also invoke when embedding credentials in configuration files, environment setup scripts, or test fixtures that could be committed to version control.
skills.description_zh: 检查源代码、配置、环境脚本及可能提交的测试夹具中硬编码的 API key、密码、令牌、连接串和私钥。

skills.name: header-injection
skills.description: Detects HTTP response header construction from user input vulnerable to CRLF injection. Use when writing code that sets HTTP response headers using values from user input, request parameters, or external data. Also invoke when constructing email headers, Content-Disposition filenames, or Location headers from caller-controlled strings.
skills.description_zh: 检查用户输入构造 HTTP 或邮件头导致 CRLF 注入的风险，涵盖 Content-Disposition 文件名及 Location 等调用方控制字符串。

skills.name: hotspots
skills.description: Maps security-sensitive code locations in a codebase to focus review effort. Use when the user asks to identify security-sensitive areas in a codebase, map the attack surface, or find where a security review should focus. Also invoke when asked to triage or prioritize security effort across a repository.
skills.description_zh: 绘制代码库安全敏感位置及攻击面，帮助分流和优先安排安全评审。

skills.name: injection
skills.description: Detects SQL, command, and template injection caused by user input reaching an interpreter without parameterization. Use when writing code that constructs database queries, builds SQL strings, executes shell commands, processes templates with user input, evaluates code dynamically, or passes user- controlled data to any external interpreter.
skills.description_zh: 检查未参数化用户输入进入解释器导致 SQL、命令或模板注入的路径，适用于查询字符串、Shell、动态代码及外部解释器。

skills.name: insecure-design
skills.description: Detects missing security controls — rate limits, MFA, re-auth — that should have been designed in from the start. Use when designing authentication flows, implementing rate limiting, building business logic for financial or access-sensitive operations, or writing code that enforces security requirements at the application layer.
skills.description_zh: 检查设计阶段缺少限流、MFA 和再次认证等控制，适用于认证、金融或权限敏感业务及应用层安全要求。

skills.name: insecure-local-storage
skills.description: Detects sensitive data written to unprotected local files, preference stores, or SQLite. Use when writing code that stores sensitive data (credentials, tokens, PII) to local files, platform preference stores (NSUserDefaults, SharedPreferences, UserDefaults), SQLite databases, or localStorage without encryption at rest.
skills.description_zh: 检查凭据、令牌和个人信息写入未加密本地文件、平台偏好、SQLite 或 localStorage 的情况。

skills.name: insecure-output-handling
skills.description: Detects unsafe rendering or execution of LLM output that enables XSS, command injection, or second-order injection. Use when writing code that renders LLM output to a UI, executes LLM-generated code or shell commands, or passes LLM responses to downstream APIs or databases. Also invoke when displaying markdown or HTML from an LLM response.
headings: Insecure Output Handling Security Check (OWASP LLM02:2025)
skills.description_zh: 检查 LLM 输出在 UI 渲染、代码执行或下游 API/数据库传递时导致 XSS、命令和二阶注入的风险，涵盖模型 Markdown/HTML 显示。

skills.name: insecure-plugin-design
skills.description: Detects LLM tool definitions without parameter validation, allowing prompt injection to escalate into file/shell/network access. Use when writing LLM tool definitions, function schemas for tool use, plugin or extension handlers, or any code that defines what actions an LLM can take via tools. Also invoke when implementing tool parameter validation.
skills.description_zh: 检查 LLM 工具、函数 schema 及插件处理缺少参数校验，让提示注入升级为文件、Shell 或网络访问的风险。

skills.name: integrity-failures
skills.description: Detects unsafe deserialization, unverified software updates, and tampered CI artifacts. Use when writing deserialization code, processing pickled or marshalled data, implementing software update mechanisms, consuming CI/CD artifact downloads, or handling data from untrusted sources that gets reconstructed into objects.
headings: Software and Data Integrity Failures Security Check (A08:2025)
skills.description_zh: 检查不安全反序列化、未验证软件更新和被篡改 CI 产物，适用于 pickle/marshal、更新机制、下载产物及不可信对象重建。

skills.name: ipc-security
skills.description: Detects IPC receivers that accept input without verifying caller identity. Use when writing URL scheme handlers, Android intent receivers or exported activities, named pipe or socket listeners, XPC service handlers, or any IPC endpoint that processes caller-supplied input without validating the caller's identity or origin.
skills.description_zh: 检查 IPC 接收端未验证调用者身份或来源，涵盖 URL scheme、Android intent/导出活动、管道套接字、XPC 和其他进程通信入口。

skills.name: llm-supply-chain
skills.description: Detects compromised or backdoored models loaded from unverified sources, floating tags, or unreviewed registries. Use when writing code that downloads pre-trained models, loads models from registries or file paths, integrates third-party LLM providers, or manages model version selection. Also invoke when setting up automated model updates.
headings: LLM Supply Chain Security Check (OWASP LLM05:2025)
skills.description_zh: 检查从未验证来源、浮动标签或未审注册表加载被篡改模型的供应链风险，适用于预训练下载、模型路径、第三方提供商、版本选择及自动更新。

skills.name: logging-failures
skills.description: Detects missing security event logs, logged secrets, and log injection through user input. Use when writing logging code, audit trails, error handlers that log, authentication event recording, or any code that writes security- relevant events. Also invoke when logging user inputs, API responses, or system actions that touch sensitive data.
headings: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures Security Check (A09:2025)
skills.description_zh: 检查安全日志缺失、秘密写日志及输入造成日志注入，适用于审计、错误、认证事件和涉及敏感数据的系统动作记录。

skills.name: mass-assignment
skills.description: Detects ORM create/update calls that spread request bodies without an explicit field allowlist. Use when writing code that creates or updates database records from request body, form data, or JSON input. Also invoke when spreading, merging, or destructuring request payloads directly into ORM model create/update calls without an explicit field allowlist.
skills.description_zh: 检查请求体、表单或 JSON 未经字段白名单直接展开、合并或解构到 ORM create/update 的批量赋值风险。

skills.name: mcp-security
skills.description: Detects MCP tool handlers vulnerable to malicious inputs, hardcoded secrets, or unrestricted file/shell access. Use when writing MCP server definitions, tool schemas, or tool handler code. Also invoke when registering tools with Claude or building Claude Code extensions that expose file system, shell, or network access.
skills.description_zh: 检查 MCP schema 和工具处理器中的恶意输入、硬编码秘密及无限制文件或 Shell 访问，适用于服务器、工具注册和暴露网络或系统权限的扩展。

skills.name: memory-api-misuse
skills.description: Detects function-local misuse of memory and resource APIs in C, C++, and Rust unsafe — allocations whose return value is not checked, frees on error paths that race the success path, locks initialized incorrectly, file descriptors leaked across exec. Use when writing or modifying C or C++ code that calls malloc/calloc/realloc/free, mmap/munmap, pthread_mutex_*, fopen/open, or any kernel/library memory or resource primitive. Use when writing Rust code inside an unsafe block that calls a raw allocation or pointer API.
skills.description_zh: 检查 C/C++ 和 Rust unsafe 函数内存及资源 API 误用，包括未查分配结果、错误路径释放竞争、锁初始化和跨 exec 描述符泄漏。覆盖分配、映射、锁、文件及裸指针调用。

skills.name: model-dos
skills.description: Detects LLM endpoints missing token caps, rate limits, or prompt-length bounds, enabling cost and resource exhaustion. Use when writing LLM API call handlers, setting up inference endpoints, implementing chatbot backends, or configuring token limits for LLM services. Also invoke when accepting user- provided prompts without length constraints.
headings: Model Denial of Service Security Check (OWASP LLM04:2025)
skills.description_zh: 检查 LLM 接口缺少令牌上限、限流或提示长度限制导致的成本与资源耗尽，适用于推理、聊天后端、服务配置和用户提示接收。

skills.name: model-theft
skills.description: Detects inference endpoints without authentication or throttling, allowing model weight reconstruction. Use when writing inference API endpoints, deploying LLM-serving infrastructure, implementing model access controls, or configuring rate limiting and authentication for model endpoints.
skills.description_zh: 检查推理端点缺少认证或节流导致模型窃取及权重重建的风险，适用于模型服务部署、访问控制和推理 API 限流配置。

skills.name: multi-agent-trust
skills.description: Detects agent-to-agent calls without authentication, authorization, or permission scoping. Use when writing code that calls other agents, spawns subagents, builds multi-agent pipelines, or passes messages between LLM agents. Also invoke when an orchestrator delegates tasks to worker agents or when agents share tools and permissions.
skills.description_zh: 检查智能体间调用缺少认证、授权或权限范围，适用于子智能体、多智能体管道、消息传递、编排委派及共享工具权限。

skills.name: nosql-injection
skills.description: Detects MongoDB and other NoSQL queries that mix user input into operators or filters without validation. Use when writing MongoDB queries, Elasticsearch queries, or other NoSQL database operations that include user-supplied input. Also invoke when building query filters from request parameters or constructing aggregation pipelines with dynamic values.
skills.description_zh: 检查 MongoDB、Elasticsearch 等 NoSQL 查询未校验输入进入运算符、过滤条件或动态聚合的注入风险。

skills.name: numeric-trust-boundary
skills.description: Detects untrusted numeric input that flows through a conversion, cast, or parser into a length, size, index, or authorization comparison without bounds-checking the post-conversion value. Use when writing or modifying code that calls atoi/strtol/parseInt/strconv.Atoi on user-supplied or network-supplied input, casts between signed and unsigned integer types, narrows an integer width before a bounds check, or uses an untrusted integer as an allocation size, array index, file offset, length argument to memcpy, or comparison gate for authorization or permission decisions.
headings: Numeric Trust Boundary (CWE-190, CWE-194, CWE-704, CWE-20)
skills.description_zh: 检查不可信数值经解析、转换、符号变更或缩窄后未再次校验边界，却用于长度、分配、索引、文件偏移或权限比较的情况。涵盖 atoi、strtol、parseInt、strconv.Atoi 等及 memcpy 长度。

skills.name: oauth-implementation
skills.description: Detects weak JWT validation, loose redirect_uri matching, and missing state parameters in OAuth/OIDC flows. Use when writing OAuth2 or OpenID Connect flows, JWT validation logic, token endpoint handling, or redirect URI processing. Also invoke when implementing any code that parses or verifies JWTs.
skills.description_zh: 检查 OAuth/OIDC 的 JWT 校验、redirect_uri 匹配和 state 参数缺陷，适用于授权流程、令牌端点、回调和 JWT 解析验证。

skills.name: open-redirect
skills.description: Detects redirects to user-controlled URLs that enable phishing and OAuth callback abuse. Use when writing code that redirects users to a URL from request parameters, form input, or any caller-controlled source. Also invoke when building login flows with "return to" URLs or OAuth callback redirects.
skills.description_zh: 检查调用方控制 URL 的开放重定向，适用于请求参数跳转、登录返回地址及 OAuth 回调，识别钓鱼或回调滥用风险。

skills.name: overreliance
skills.description: Detects systems that treat LLM output as authoritative fact in consequential decisions without human review. Use when writing code that displays LLM output as authoritative fact, uses LLM decisions to gate consequential outcomes without human review, or builds automated pipelines where LLM judgment drives downstream actions.
skills.description_zh: 检查在重大决策中未经人工复核将 LLM 输出视为权威事实或据此控制结果的系统，涵盖模型判断驱动下游动作的自动管道。

skills.name: path-traversal
skills.description: Detects file operations with user-controlled paths vulnerable to ../ traversal, absolute paths, or symlink escapes. Use when writing code that opens, reads, writes, or deletes files using paths constructed from user input. Also invoke when serving static files, handling file downloads by name, or resolving paths from URL parameters or request bodies.
skills.description_zh: 检查用户路径导致 ../、绝对路径或符号链接逃逸，适用于文件读写删除、静态服务、按名称下载及 URL/请求体路径解析。

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Lightweight per-PR security gate that detects Critical and High severity OWASP/LLM issues in changed files only. Use when scanning a small git diff in CI for blocking findings. Single-pass; does not dispatch subagents and does not perform threat modeling or attack-chain analysis.
skills.description_zh: 在小型 PR 差异的变更文件中单次检查严重及高危 OWASP/LLM 问题，作为 CI 阻断关卡，不分派子智能体或执行威胁模型及攻击链分析。

skills.name: privilege-handling
skills.description: Detects unsafe privilege handling in SUID/SGID binaries, environment-variable trust in privileged code, insecure umask, temp-file races, and symlink-follow bugs in /tmp. Use when writing or modifying SUID/SGID-installed code, code that drops or elevates privileges via setuid/setgid/seteuid/seteuid_r, anything that reads PATH/LD_*/IFS environment variables, code that creates files in /tmp or other world-writable directories, or anything that opens a file whose path may contain a symlink controlled by a less-privileged user.
skills.description_zh: 检查 SUID/SGID、权限提升下降、环境变量信任、umask、临时文件竞争及符号链接问题，适用于特权代码和 /tmp 等公共可写目录的文件操作。

skills.name: prompt-injection
skills.description: Detects LLM prompts built from user input or retrieved documents that let attackers hijack the model's instructions. Use when writing code that constructs LLM prompts from user input, builds system prompts, implements RAG pipelines, or processes external documents fed to a model. Also invoke when external data can influence LLM context.
skills.description_zh: 检查用户或检索文档进入提示后劫持模型指令的风险，适用于系统提示、RAG、外部文档及影响 LLM 上下文的数据。

skills.name: prototype-pollution
skills.description: Detects JavaScript deep-merges or property assignment from user input that can pollute Object.prototype. Use when writing JavaScript or TypeScript code that deep-merges, clones, or extends objects using user-controlled input. Also invoke when using lodash merge/set, Object.assign with dynamic keys, or recursive property copy on untrusted data.
skills.description_zh: 检查 JavaScript/TypeScript 对不可信对象深合并、克隆、动态属性或递归复制导致 Object.prototype 污染，涵盖 lodash merge/set 和动态 Object.assign。

skills.name: race-condition
skills.description: Detects check-then-act sequences on shared state vulnerable to TOCTOU manipulation. Use when writing check-then-act sequences on shared state, file operations that check existence before read/write, balance updates without locking, or any code where two operations on the same resource are not atomic.
skills.description_zh: 检查共享状态先检查后操作的 TOCTOU 竞争，适用于文件存在检查、无锁余额更新及同一资源非原子操作。

skills.name: rag-security
skills.description: Detects RAG pipelines that ingest external documents into LLM context without sanitization or trust gating. Use when building RAG pipelines, ingesting external documents into vector stores, or retrieving content from external sources to include in LLM context. Also invoke when writing code that fetches URLs or parses documents for LLM prompts.
skills.description_zh: 检查 RAG 外部文档未经净化或信任关卡进入向量库及 LLM 上下文，适用于 URL 获取、文档解析和外部检索。

skills.name: redos
skills.description: Detects regex patterns vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking on crafted inputs. Use when writing regular expressions that will be applied to user- supplied input. Also invoke when compiling regexes from external configuration, building input validation patterns, or parsing untrusted strings with regex.
skills.description_zh: 检查用户输入适用的正则是否存在灾难性回溯，涵盖外部配置正则、输入校验及不可信文本解析。

skills.name: security-cleanup
skills.description: Applies fixes for security findings produced by /security-review. Use when the user wants to fix security issues found by /security-review or when they ask to clean up, remediate, or apply fixes for security findings.
skills.description_zh: 实施 /security-review 所报告安全发现的修复，适用于清理和整改已发现问题。

skills.name: security-misconfiguration
skills.description: Detects insecure defaults, overly permissive CORS, exposed debug endpoints, and missing security headers. Use when writing server configuration, setting environment variables, configuring CORS policies, enabling debug modes, setting up default credentials, or deploying application infrastructure. Also invoke when writing security headers middleware.
skills.description_zh: 检查不安全默认、过宽 CORS、公开调试端点及缺少安全头，适用于服务器、环境变量、默认凭据、基础设施及响应头中间件。

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Runs a full OWASP/CWE security audit via isolated subagents. Use when the user types /security-review or explicitly requests a full security audit of the current code.
headings: Stages 1b + 2 — Design review and vulnerability audit (parallel)
skills.description_zh: 在用户输入 /security-review 或明确要求完整安全审计时，通过隔离子智能体执行 OWASP/CWE 全面代码审查。

skills.name: sensitive-disclosure
skills.description: Detects PII, credentials, and secrets passed to LLM APIs or embedded in system prompts. Use when writing code that passes sensitive data (PII, credentials, health data) to an LLM API, constructs system prompts containing secrets, returns LLM responses that could contain training data, or implements memory/context persistence.
skills.description_zh: 检查个人信息、凭据、健康数据或秘密传入 LLM API、嵌入系统提示，以及回答潜在训练数据泄漏和记忆上下文持久化的风险。

skills.name: ssrf
skills.description: Detects HTTP requests to user-controlled URLs that can reach internal services or cloud metadata endpoints. Use when writing code that makes HTTP requests to URLs constructed from user input, fetches resources from caller-specified addresses, or proxies requests on behalf of users. Also invoke when implementing webhook receivers or URL preview features.
skills.description_zh: 检查用户控制 HTTP URL 可访问内部服务或云元数据的 SSRF，涵盖资源获取、代理、webhook 和 URL 预览。

skills.name: supply-chain
skills.description: Detects supply-chain risks in dependency manifests, lockfiles, install commands, and CI pipelines — missing lockfiles, absent vulnerability scanners, unverified installs, install hooks that pipe remote content to a shell, and AI-hallucinated package names. Use when writing package install commands, dependency manifests, CI/CD configs, build scripts, or code that loads external packages.
skills.description_zh: 检查依赖清单、锁文件、安装和 CI 的供应链风险，包括无锁文件或漏洞扫描、未验证安装、远程内容直接传 Shell 及 AI 虚构包名。

skills.name: threat-model
skills.description: Produces a threat model — purpose, deployment, trusted inputs, untrusted inputs — for a new feature or component before it's implemented. Use when writing an implementation plan for a new API endpoint, data pipeline, agent loop, or system component. Also invoke when a plan introduces new trust boundaries, handles user-supplied data, adds authentication flows, or integrates external services.
headings: Threat Model — <one-line summary derived from purpose>
skills.description_zh: 在新功能或组件实现前明确用途、部署、可信和不可信输入，形成威胁模型。适用于 API、数据管道、智能体循环、新信任边界、用户数据、认证和外部集成。

skills.name: token-smuggling
skills.description: Detects user input passed to LLMs without Unicode normalization, allowing RTL overrides, zero-width joiners, and homoglyph attacks. Use when writing code that passes user-supplied strings to an LLM, constructs prompts from external data, or processes text that may contain Unicode control characters, homoglyphs, or invisible formatting characters.
skills.description_zh: 检查用户文本进入 LLM 前未规范化 Unicode，导致 RTL 控制、零宽字符和同形字攻击的风险，适用于外部提示及不可见格式字符处理。

skills.name: training-data-poisoning
skills.description: Detects training and fine-tuning pipelines that ingest external data without integrity gating. Use when writing fine-tuning pipelines, dataset ingestion scripts, external training data loaders, or code that collects and processes data for model training. Also invoke when automating dataset curation from web scraping or user-contributed sources.
headings: Training Data Poisoning Security Check (OWASP LLM03:2025)
skills.description_zh: 检查训练及微调管道未经完整性关卡接收外部数据，涵盖数据集摄取、网络抓取、用户贡献及自动整理。

skills.name: unsafe-api-consumption
skills.description: Detects code that consumes third-party API responses without type validation or sanitization. Use when writing code that calls third-party APIs, parses responses from external services, or integrates with webhooks and callbacks from external systems. Also invoke when deserializing or acting on data received from partner or vendor APIs without validation.
skills.description_zh: 检查第三方 API、webhook、回调及合作方响应未经类型校验或净化即反序列化和执行的风险。

headings: On demand: three review modes for existing code

For read-only review, downgrade to contents:read.
Do NOT trigger on fork PRs — GITHUB_TOKEN from a fork cannot write back to the
base repo, and untrusted fork code runs with write permissions.
